notice:
Example sentences from [Tatoeba](https://tatoeba.org), export of 2026-11-21, written by Tatoeba's contributors and shared under [CC BY 2.0 FR](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/); some are [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Each sentence's owner (as listed by Tatoeba) and its page on Tatoeba are listed in the pack's [credits.tsv](https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin/blob/main/plugins/data/zh-sentences-tatoeba/credits.tsv).

qinqin chose these sentences with a program: it kept sentences with an English translation, preferred native speakers, and dropped flagged, duplicate and unsuitable ones. The pinyin and the filing under words were generated from [CC-CEDICT](https://cc-cedict.org) (MDBG, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)); a reading is left out where a word has several. The selection, the readings and the links to dictionary words were made automatically and may contain errors.
